title: THE CAPTAIN CALLS FOR YOU
stanzas: There's another task to do, there's a battle to renew; And the captain calls for you, Volunteers! Volunteers! Rally to the throbbing drum! Shout the word we come, we come! Volunteers! Volunteers! Volunteers!

Who can dally in the dale? Who can doff his unstained mail. Christian soldiers cannot fail! Volunteers! Volunteers! Buckle now your armour on, charge until the fight is won. Volunteers! Volunteers! Volunteers!

Hear the foreman's fading shout, See His cohorts turn in routE Nevermore the end in doubt! Volunteers! Volunteers! We are in the winning fight, Shout! For the victory's in sight, Volunteers! Volunteers! Volunteers!
chorus: Christ before us, Christ behind us, Christ on every side! For the rescue of mankind, onto glory ride! Volunteers! Volunteers! Volunteers!
